name: fraction_role
description: Extract numerator or denominator of a written fraction; controls extract first or second member of an integer pair.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
a=[];c=[]
for i in range(120):
 x,y=random.sample(range(1,40),2);r=random.randrange(2)
 a.append({'prompt':f'In the fraction {x}/{y}, what is the '+['numerator','denominator'][r]+'? Answer:','answer':' '+str([x,y][r])})
 c.append({'prompt':f'In the pair ({x}, {y}), what is the '+['first','second'][r]+' number? Answer:','answer':' '+str([x,y][r])})
json.dump({'items':a,'control':c},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
